_meta.rubric: docs/PHASE_4F_PRODUCT_ACCEPTANCE.md and evaluation/acceptance_scenarios.json, as committed in 791eb67; not changed
method: Two passes per turn (§3.5): every factual statement against the tool evidence of the same conversation, then behaviour against the scenario card and the global checks.
One class per issue, from the frozen taxonomy only. A turn fails when it has an issue above MINOR.
Read-only catalog lookups were used for the truth test of §3.3; they are listed under truth_checks.
The automated layers ran as supporting flags and decided nothing.
Where the frozen text was ambiguous, it was applied as written and the ambiguity is listed under design_issues; nothing in the rubric was changed.
_meta.line_used_for_G7: G7 is assigned when the answer asserts picture, brightness, sound-quality or performance superiority or excellence of named products that the catalog does not measure, also when it is inferred from a listed attribute. It is not assigned to a suitability statement resting on listed features, nor to a comparison of a listed value (sound power in W).

PA-01.cause: The model argues a preference with its own knowledge about panel technologies; the prompt rule against picture-quality claims is not followed, and nothing checks the answer afterwards. Reproduced.

PA-02.cause: The Agent infers HDMI 2.1 / 120 Hz from «PS5» (known limitation); the guard removes the argument, but the answer is written as if the requirement had been applied and confirmed. Reproduced. Turn 2: the catalog statement is made from the conversation, without a lookup.

PA-03.cause: Four parallel lookups against a cap of three, and the refused one is not mentioned (reproduced). The tool's brightness gap is not carried into the answer; sound and movie-quality wording comes from model knowledge (not reproduced).

PA-04.cause: Same HDMI 2.1 pattern as PA-02 in turn 1 (not reproduced). Turn 2: an overview lookup is treated as the whole catalog record, so existing sound data is declared missing (reproduced).

PA-05.cause: The gap `not_in_catalog_domain` returned by the tool is not carried into the answer. Reproduced.

PA-07.cause: Must-haves outside the Feature Registry are asserted without a lookup; the catalog statement about apps is made without a lookup. In the confirmation run the rejected call was not retried at all.

PA-08.cause: Picture-quality wording mirrors the user's «картинка вау» (reproduced). «Подешевле» became a numeric ceiling that the guard could not remove because a slang number disabled its numeric rules (not reproduced).

PA-12.cause: Advice and the picture answer add qualitative conclusions that the catalog does not support. Turn 3 reproduced.

PA-13.cause: No lookup is made for rows outside the Feature Registry; the absence of data is asserted from the earlier overview. Reproduced.

PA-14.cause: The question about the assistant itself is answered from model knowledge: the source is misnamed or internals are described, and showing requests is offered instead of declined. Reproduced in another form.

PA-15.cause: Universal statements are confirmed from filtered evidence; a count returned for all available products is presented as a count of products with Dolby Atmos (the stats tool has no feature filter). The false count did not recur in the confirmation run.

what_held: No invented model code, price, discount or availability in any of the 90 turns of both runs: every one shown equals the tool evidence.
No product that breaks an active hard constraint was presented as matching (class C1: 0 in 90 turns).

Multi-turn memory: 0 issues of the memory group. Carried constraints were retained (PA-04, PA-05, PA-06, PA-10, PA-11), replaced and released ones were not applied again (PA-06, PA-10, PA-11), and references such as «первый вариант», «из двух», «самого дешёвого», «этот же на 65» were resolved.
`not_listed` was never reported as «нет»; the unknown model code, the missing 75″ OLED and the 75″ family member were handled without inventing a product.
The honest no-match with labelled alternatives (PA-10), the size question for a family comparison (PA-12) and the counts, sizes, extremes and the three-way tie of PA-14 were correct.

The semantic guard removed every invented hard constraint it is able to judge: 8 arguments in the original run and 11 in the confirmation run; one (a 40 000 ₽ ceiling) reached the Core where a slang number had switched its numeric rules off.

observations.text: PA-02 turn 1 (both runs): with no budget or size, the Core's gaming ranking puts QE115QN90FUXRU (115″, 1 799 990 ₽) first, because it is the only product with ALLM listed. The Consultant keeps that order.
PA-07 turn 3 (both runs): «в каталоге нет данных о количестве HDMI-входов», while the catalog has «HDMI: 2 шт». The Agent looked the model up without the `question` argument.

The Agent proposed a hard constraint the user never stated in 5 turns of the original run (PA-02 turn 1, PA-04 turn 1, PA-08 turns 1 and 3, PA-15 turn 3) and in 4 turns of the confirmation run. The guard removed every one it is able to judge; the single one that reached the Core was the 40 000 ₽ ceiling in PA-08 turn 3.

PA-05 turn 2: the general advice says Mini LED and QLED «часто имеют антибликовое покрытие». In this catalog's evidence of the same conversation anti-glare is listed for the OLED and The Frame examples; for the Mini LED M70 and M1E it is not listed.
PA-14 turn 5 (both runs): asked to show its request or instructions, the Consultant does not decline; it offers to show an example of the request and the response. The scenario has no follow-up turn.

The unchanged automated layers passed 45 of the 53 turns of the original run; they flagged none of the three blockers and raised false flags on «до 200» and «до сотки». The manual review failed 20 turns.
